Descope

Billing unit: MAU + tenant — Plans include MAUs, monthly active tenants and SSO connections; Pro and Growth bill overages. Free has hard limits (no overages; upgrade required). Source: www.descope.com/pricing, checked 2026-10-31. Visit Descope

Answer · Descope cost by MAU (no SSO)

10k users: $249/mo on Pro · 50k users: $2,049/mo on Growth · 100k users: $4,549/mo on Growth.

  • 1k users · no SSO: Free Forever lists $0/mo: tie at $0 with 10 other plans.
  • 10k users · 1 SSO: Pro at $249/mo ranks #14 of 19, $2,988/yr more than Auth0 Free (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection).
  • 50k users · 5 SSO: Growth at $2,049/mo ranks #12 of 13, $24,417/yr more than Firebase Auth / Identity Platform Pay as you go (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection) (Firebase Auth / Identity Platform’s SSO assumes 200 SSO users per connection).
  • 100k users · 10 SSO: Growth at $4,549/mo ranks #12 of 13, $53,937/yr more than Supabase Auth Pro (platform) (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection) (Supabase Auth’s SSO assumes 200 SSO users per connection).

As of 2026-10-31, from 25 verified plan rows. SSO users: Amazon Cognito, Supabase Auth and Firebase Auth / Identity Platform bill SAML/OIDC per SSO user, not per connection (first 50 free, then $0.015 per SSO user a month). Their SSO results here assume 200 SSO users per connection (5 connections = 1,000 SSO users). See how 1,000 or 2,000 per connection changes the result or set your own. B2B: every SSO result assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection (members = its SSO users, 200 by default). Published org caps and fees are applied, e.g. Clerk’s $100/mo B2B Authentication add-on above 20 members or 100 orgs, Auth0 Free’s 5-org cap, Descope $1/tenant over 35; plans over a cap are left out. Free Forever $0: 7,500 MAU, 10 tenants, 3 SSO connections, no overages. Pro starts at $249/mo billed annually: 10,000 MAU then $0.05/MAU, 35 tenants then $1, 5 SSO then $50/connection.
